name: @appeeky/agentthumbs
description: Give your AI agent a real phone: MCP server, CLI and TypeScript library for Android phones and iPhones.
author: Appeeky (https://appeeky.com)

scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p native && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target arm64-apple-macos14.0 -o native/agentthumbs-mirroring-arm64 swift/main.swift && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -target x86_64-apple-macos14.0 -o native/agentthumbs-mirroring-x86_64 swift/main.swift && lipo -create -output native/agentthumbs-mirroring native/agentthumbs-mirroring-arm64 native/agentthumbs-mirroring-x86_64 && rm native/agentthumbs-mirroring-arm64 native/agentthumbs-mirroring-x86_64
